items.q: The Prophet who saw eleven stars, the sun and the moon bowing to him in a dream.
The father of Yusuf (عليه السلام), also a Prophet.
Yusuf's brothers threw him into this.
The Prophet who spoke with Allah and is called "Kalim Allah".
The brother of Musa (عليه السلام) who helped him.
The tyrant king who claimed to be a god in the time of Musa (عليه السلام).
Musa's staff turned into this.
Musa (عليه السلام) struck the sea and it did this.
The Prophet given the Zabur.
The Prophet who understood the speech of birds and ants.
The Prophet swallowed by a great fish.
The Prophet known for great patience in illness.
The Prophet born without a father.
The mother of 'Isa (عليه السلام).
'Isa (عليه السلام) spoke as a baby in this.
The old Prophet who prayed for a son and was given Yahya (عليه السلام).
The son of Zakariyya (عليه السلام).
The Prophet sent to Madyan, who told his people to give full measure.
The bird that brought news of the Queen of Saba' to Sulayman (عليه السلام).
The one who killed Jalut in battle.
Yusuf's brothers brought back his shirt stained with this.
Yusuf (عليه السلام) was sold for a few of these coins.
The title of the official in Egypt who bought Yusuf (عليه السلام).
Yusuf (عليه السلام) chose this over doing wrong.
The king dreamt of seven fat cows eaten by seven of these.
Yusuf (عليه السلام) asked to be put in charge of this.
Ya'qub (عليه السلام) regained his sight when this was cast over his face.
Musa's mother put him in a box on this river.
The wife of Fir'awn who adopted Musa (عليه السلام) and believed, named in the reports.
Musa (عليه السلام) fled to this land and worked there for years.
Musa (عليه السلام) first saw this on the mountain and went toward it.
Musa (عليه السلام) was told to take off these in the sacred valley.
The sacred valley where Allah spoke to Musa (عليه السلام).
The man who made the golden calf.
The food sent down to the Children of Isra'il in the desert.
The number of springs that gushed from the rock when Musa (عليه السلام) struck it.
The rich man of Musa's people who was swallowed by the earth.
Dawud (عليه السلام) was taught to make this from iron.
The Queen of Saba', named in the reports.
Yunus (عليه السلام) prayed from the darkness, "There is no god but You, glory be to You..." (meaning), in this surah.
The number of Yusuf's brothers, counted from his dream.
The brother of Yusuf (عليه السلام) kept back in Egypt, named in the reports.
Yusuf (عليه السلام) had this put in his brother's bag.
Ya'qub (عليه السلام) said this kind of patience is best.
The women cut their hands when they saw Yusuf (عليه السلام) because they were cutting this.
The number of signs (ayat) given to Musa (عليه السلام), in Surah al-Isra'.
Besides the staff, Musa's other main sign: his hand came out like this.
Fir'awn's minister, named in the Qur'an.
The believing man of Fir'awn's family who hid his faith; the surah is also named after him.
Musa (عليه السلام) asked Allah to untie this from his tongue.
Musa (عليه السلام) was given the Tawrah after this many nights on the mountain.
The people told to slaughter a cow, which gave the surah al-Baqarah its name.
The wise servant whom Musa (عليه السلام) followed to learn.
Al-Khidr made a hole in a boat, killed a boy and did this.
The king of the Children of Isra'il chosen by Allah, under whom Dawud (عليه السلام) fought.
Sulayman (عليه السلام) was given control of this, which blew by his command.
The death of Sulayman (عليه السلام) was only found out when a creature ate this.
Ayyub (عليه السلام) was told to strike the ground with this, and water came out.
'Isa (عليه السلام) made birds from clay and they flew, by this.
The disciples of 'Isa (عليه السلام) are called this in the Qur'an.
The Prophet whose people were the only ones to believe in time and be saved from punishment.
Yunus (عليه السلام) was cast onto the shore and Allah grew this plant over him.
Yunus (عليه السلام) was sent to more than this many people.
Yunus (عليه السلام) is called this, "the companion of the fish".
The Prophet mentioned among the patient in Surah al-Anbiya', with Isma'il and Idris.
The Prophet sent to people who worshipped the idol Ba'l.
The Prophet named with Isma'il and Dhul-Kifl in Surah Sad.
Dawud (عليه السلام) was judged on the case of two disputants who climbed over this.
items.a: The wall of his prayer room (mihrab)

items.q: Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ said the most beloved fasting to Allah was the fast of this Prophet (paraphrased).
items.a: Dawud (عليه السلام), fasting every other day

items.q: Dawud (عليه السلام) ate only from this, as our Beloved Prophet ﷺ said (paraphrased).
items.a: The work of his own hands

items.q: The throne of the Queen of Saba' was brought to Sulayman (عليه السلام) in this short time by one with knowledge of the Book.
The Prophet who inherited from Dawud (عليه السلام).
The Queen of Saba' and her people worshipped this.
The palace floor of Sulayman (عليه السلام) was made of this, so it looked like water.
Shu'ayb's people were destroyed on "the day of the shadow", in this surah.
The people of Shu'ayb (عليه السلام) are called this, "the people of the thicket".
Zakariyya (عليه السلام) was given a sign of not speaking for this many days.
Zakariyya (عليه السلام) found this with Maryam (عليها السلام) whenever he entered her prayer room.
Allah says 'Isa (عليه السلام) was not killed or this.
The surah named after the table sent down at the request of the disciples.
Yusuf (عليه السلام) stayed in prison for "some years", the word used is this.
The two young men in prison dreamt of pressing grapes and of carrying this on the head.
Yusuf (عليه السلام) raised his parents on this when they came to Egypt.
Ya'qub (عليه السلام) is also called this name.
Musa (عليه السلام) killed an Egyptian by mistake with this.
A man came running from the far end of the city to warn Musa (عليه السلام) that the chiefs were plotting to do this.
Musa (عليه السلام) agreed to work for eight years, or this many if he chose.
The daughter in Madyan said the best to hire is one who is strong and this.
The plagues sent on Fir'awn's people include flood, locusts, lice, frogs and this.
The sorcerers of Fir'awn believed and he threatened to cut off their hands and feet and do this.
The place where Musa (عليه السلام) and al-Khidr met, "the meeting of the two seas".
Musa (عليه السلام) lost this, which was the sign of where al-Khidr would be.
The servant who travelled with Musa (عليه السلام), named in the hadith.
The Children of Isra'il wandered for this many years.
Talut tested his army at this.
The jinn worked for Sulayman (عليه السلام) making these, as large as reservoirs.
Sulayman (عليه السلام) was given a spring of this metal.
'Isa (عليه السلام) gave good news of a Messenger after him named this.
Maryam (عليها السلام) was told to shake the trunk of this.
The surah in which Maryam (عليها السلام) is called "sister of Harun".
